下面代码是在对处理好的差分时间序列数据训练一个贝叶斯VAR模型（BVAR），且为了保证结果可复现，先固定随机种子。

```{r, include=FALSE}
# ------------------------------------------
#  安装必要包（如未安装，请取消注释运行）
# ------------------------------------------
install.packages("remotes")
install.packages("BVAR")
install.packages("readr")
```


```{r, include=FALSE}
install.packages("readxl")
install.packages("lubridate")
install.packages("dplyr")
install.packages("ggplot2")
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(BVAR)       # CRAN 包用于层级Bayesian VAR 模型 :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1}
library(readxl)
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
# 参数
window_size <- 120   # 训练窗口长度
horizon <- 4         # 预测步长
roll_steps <- 30     # 滚动次数

# 结果存储
all_forecasts <- list()
all_truths <- list()

# 假设路径为：
B_path <- "/Users/lihongyu/Desktop/weekly_speed.csv"
C_path <- "/Users/lihongyu/Desktop/weekly_weighted_teu.csv"
A_path <- "/Users/lihongyu/Desktop/weekly_with_CCFI(PCI优化).csv"  # ⚠️ 替换为你的 Excel 路径
df <- read_csv(A_path)

# ------------------------------------------
#  数据处理与筛选
# ------------------------------------------
df <- df %>%
  mutate(week = as.Date(week)) %>%
  filter(week >= as.Date("2021-03-20") & week <= as.Date("2023-12-31")) %>% # 选择时间范围
  rename(
    CCFI = CCFI_weekly_avg,
    Brent = Brent_Oil_Avg,
    Policy = weekly_avg_policy_index,
    VIX = weighted_oil_vix
  ) %>%
  select(week, IPCI, Brent, Policy, VIX, CCFI) # 选择变量



# 读取 B 路径数据
df_B <- read_csv(B_path) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date) + 1) %>%   # 日期加一天
  select(date, avg_speed)
head(df_B)

# 读取 C 路径数据
df_C <- read_csv(C_path) %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
  ) %>%
  select(date, weighted_teu)
# 主数据：已读入为 df，先把 week 改为 date，便于 merge
df <- df %>%
  rename(date = week)

# 合并 B、C 到主数据
df <- df %>%
  left_join(df_C, by = "date") %>%
  left_join(df_B, by = "date")

# 重新筛选时间范围（从 2020-01-20 起）
df <- df %>%
  filter(date >= as.Date("2021-03-20")) %>%
  select(date, IPCI, Brent, Policy, VIX, avg_speed, weighted_teu, CCFI)
range(df$date)
head(df,120)





```
```{r}
# ------------------------------------------
#  训练模型
# ------------------------------------------
for(i in 0:(roll_steps - 1)) {
  
  train_start <- i + 1
  train_end <- train_start + window_size - 1
  pred_start <- train_end + 1
  pred_end <- pred_start + horizon - 1
  
  if(pred_end > nrow(df)) break
  
  # 取训练集
  train_df <- df[train_start:train_end, ]  
  
  # 差分，去掉第一行NA
  # 差分处理
  diff_train_df <- train_df %>%
    arrange(date) %>%
    mutate(across(c(IPCI, Brent, weighted_teu, avg_speed,CCFI), ~ . - lag(.))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(CCFI))
  
  X_train <- diff_train_df %>%
    select(IPCI, Brent,  weighted_teu, avg_speed, CCFI) %>%
    na.omit() %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), scale)) %>%  # 🔥 在这里加上归一化
    as.matrix()
    cat("X_train 行数为：", nrow(X_train), "\n")

  set.seed(123)
  model <- bvar(X_train, lags = 4, draws = 1500, burnin = 500)
  
  # 预测
  fc <- predict(model, horizon = horizon)
  
  head(fc)
  var_idx <- which(fc$variables == "CCFI")
  print(var_idx)
  
  ccfi_diff_forecast <- fc$fcast[, , var_idx]  # dim: 模拟次数 x horizon
  
  # 差分还原预测值（取均值）
  last_ccfi <- train_df$CCFI[nrow(train_df)]  # 训练集最后一期原始CCFI
  ccfi_pred_matrix <- t(apply(ccfi_diff_forecast, 1, cumsum)) + last_ccfi
  ccfi_mean_pred <- apply(ccfi_pred_matrix, 2, mean)  # 预测均值
  
  # 真实CCFI
    # ⚠️ 更稳健地获取真实CCFI
  train_end_date <- train_df$date[nrow(train_df)]
  last_idx <- which(df$date == train_end_date)

# 安全检查：确保不会越界
  if ((last_idx + horizon) > nrow(df)) break

  true_ccfi <- df$CCFI[(last_idx + 1):(last_idx + horizon)]
  print(ccfi_mean_pred)
  print(true_ccfi)
  # 存储结果
  all_forecasts[[i+1]] <- ccfi_mean_pred
  all_truths[[i+1]] <- true_ccfi
}

# 合并预测与真实
pred_mat <- do.call(rbind, all_forecasts)
truth_mat <- do.call(rbind, all_truths)

# 计算第4周误差
mse_4 <- mean((pred_mat[, 4] - truth_mat[, 4])^2)
mae_4 <- mean(abs(pred_mat[, 4] - truth_mat[, 4]))

cat("第4周预测 MSE =", mse_4, "\n")
cat("第4周预测 MAE =", mae_4, "\n")
```




```{r}
# ------------------------------------------
#  画图直观展示
# ------------------------------------------

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

# 取所有滚动预测第1周的预测值和真实值(也可以其他周)
pred_h1 <- sapply(all_forecasts, function(x) x[4])  # 取每轮预测的第1周
truth_h1 <- sapply(all_truths, function(x) x[4])    # 真实值第1周

# 构造时间序列对应的week（预测起点时间）
# 预测起点是训练集最后一周后1周，即 df$week 窗口大小之后的日期
time_labels <- df$date[(window_size + 1):(window_size + length(pred_h1))]

# 构造绘图数据框
plot_df <- tibble(
  Week = time_labels,
  Prediction = pred_h1,
  Truth = truth_h1
) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("Prediction", "Truth"), names_to = "Type", values_to = "CCFI")

# 画图
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Week, y = CCFI, color = Type)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Rolling Forecast: Horizon 1 CCFI Prediction vs Truth",
    x = "Week",
    y = "CCFI Index",
    color = "Legend"
  ) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%Y-W%V", date_breaks = "4 weeks") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

```
